rows.title: Appointment
rows.summary: Baba Food Processing (India) Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of  Prof. Dr. Koyilathumpaday Sukumaran Sujit as Non- Executive Independent Director of the company w.e.f. October 17, 2026.

rows.title: Outcome of Board Meeting
rows.summary: Baba Food Processing (India) Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on October 17, 2026.

rows.title: Integrated Filing- Governance
rows.summary: Baba Food Processing (India) Limited has informed the exchange regarding Submission of Statement of Investor Grievances pursuant to Regulation 13(3) of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 for the quarter ended September 30, 2026
